observations.description: trading_authority always False: submission rejects True, event rejects True, snapshot has False, decision has False. No live-order capability in docstring.

Submission idempotency: exact retry returns original record (IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY), same key with different fingerprint → DUPLICATE_CONFLICT, duplicate order_id → DUPLICATE_CONFLICT. Idempotency checked before safety gates.
Market/auth gates: kill switch, disconnected, reconciliation, unauthorized, stale market data, future market data. Boundary equality: market_data_age exactly at maximum accepted.

Exposure controls: per-order notional > max rejects, aggregate notional + new > max_total rejects, open count >= max_open_orders rejects. Terminal orders excluded from open exposure. Boundary equality at exact limit accepted.

Strict lifecycle: partial fills conserve quantity, final fill requires exact equality (filled==quantity), overfill rejects, cancel preserves filled quantity, terminal state rejects further events, stale version rejects, time regression rejects, events before acceptance reject.

Event idempotency: exact event replay is no-op (EVENT_REPLAY), same event_id with changed fingerprint → EVENT_CONFLICT. Idempotency checked before terminal state — replay of completed event on terminal order returns EVENT_REPLAY, new event on terminal returns TERMINAL_ORDER.

Restart/reconciliation: snapshot_id binds policy+connected+kill_switch+reconciliation+records. Disconnect sets connected=False, reconciliation_required=True. Mismatch → kill_switch=True, connected=False, reconciliation=True. Exact observation → connected=True, reconciliation=False. Resume detects tampered snapshot_id and trading_authority=True.
Integration: imports only OrderIntentV2 from contracts. Order identity (order_id, market) preserved in record. No LiveOrder/live_order/submit_live. No parallel live authority.
Policy validation: per-order cannot exceed total, max_open_orders>=1, market_data_age>0, positive notional. All reject with ValueError.
No network/credential/live imports. Only dataclass, datetime, decimal, enum, hashlib, json, contracts used.
